messages:
Ava (CEO): quick live/thread for anyone who had follow-ups after the security segment. leave questions about SOC2/ISO timing, KMS/BYOK, VPC private deployments, and audit log exports and we'll answer in thread or after.
Priya (Eng): hello - curious if the hosted API plan can ever support customer-managed keys without full Private deployment? some customers want BYOK but don't need VPC.
Samir (Head of Security): short take: we currently require Dedicated or Private for full BYOK because we need tenant isolation for key access. that said, we
re prototyping a hosted-BYOK flow where key material remains in the customer's KMS and we use ephemeral credentials and constrained access. not GA yet.
Jordan (VP Product): to add: hosted-BYOK is gated by compliance and perf testing. if you have customers lobbying for it, send their names to growth and we'll prioritize.
Lena (Compliance): SOC2/ISO update: SOC2 Type II audit window planned for August, auditor chosen, evidence collection kickoff early July. ISO 27001 kickoff slated for October. Expect questionnaires from legal once audit windows open.
Priya (Eng): about logs: can we stream full request/response logs to S3 for long-term retention? customers ask for >1 year retention.
Samir (Head of Security): Hosted default retention=90 days. We provide log export to S3/Kinesis/Syslog for Dedicated/Private; for hosted we can arrange long-term retention as a paid add-on with redaction controls. we'll also offer a managed export connector to push to customer buckets.
Ava (CEO): important: any export of plaintext prompts must be opt-in and documented in DPA. coordinate with legal on contracts.
ops-bot: Reminder: security runbook updated by Samir: https://redwood.example.com/security/runbooks/exporting-logs (automated)
Priya (Eng): technical question: when streaming to S3, are audit logs batched or per-event? and are they signed?
Samir (Head of Security): they are streamed as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), batched hourly by default, and each file is checksummed and signed with our internal signing key; customers can enable server-side encryption with their KMS.
Jordan (VP Product): roadmap note: we'll add configurable retention windows and per-customer export policies under "security-export-12".
Lena (Compliance): who can request unredacted logs for investigations? need process for auditors and legal holds.
Samir (Head of Security): unredacted access requires an approved retention request and an escalation form. permissions: only people with role "security:incident_investigator" plus 2nd approver. all such accesses are logged and immutable. auditors can get time-limited access under NDA and with legal approval.
Priya (Eng): for BYOK, how do we handle key rotation without downtime?
Samir (Head of Security): KMS patterns: support atomic key pointer swaps. rotation steps: create new key -> rewrap DEKs -> swap active pointer. we do the swap atomically so in-flight requests transition without fail. documented SLO is <5 minutes for full rollover in Dedicated; Private depends on customer infra.
Ava (CEO): any blockers we should triage now?
Jordan (VP Product): we need a small doc/FAQ for sales about hosted-BYOK constraints so AEs don't promise things. Priya can draft.
Priya (Eng): I'll draft and post in #product-ops; ping me if customers need priority.
Lena (Compliance): action: I'll coordinate evidence list for SOC2 and share with infra to pre-populate.
Samir (Head of Security): final note: for on-prem customers we can integrate with FIPS/HSM modules and provide attestation. reach out to security for integration checklist.
Ava (CEO): thanks team. we'll close this thread but please add any follow-ups here and we'll answer after. :sparkles:
